svg.aria-label: The plan chart's three panels -- price, heating power and temperatures -- with each of its seven series, the now marker, the editable slot lanes and the shared time axis numbered, and a key naming them
svg.text: Seven series in three panels on one shared time axis, each panel on its own scale. Every chip in the legend toggles one series and rescales its panel.

rect.title: Space heating and hot water share these quarter hours: the pump alternates circuits within each step, hot water first. Their combined power never exceeds the heat pump's maximum — this is time-sharing, not double-booking.
